name: Price watch
summary: A listing that keeps dropping: its price tag hangs on a nail with the old prices crossed out, and beside it a price ruler where friends stick pins at what they'd pay; when the seller drops into anyone's pin, the highest pin gets the first message.
useWhen: 'that standing desk dropped again, it's $140 now'
waiting for a marketplace listing to get cheaper
who gets dibs on messaging the seller if the price drops
i'd pay like $110 for that, max
a few friends watching the same listing's price
dontUseWhen: deciding if a price is fair right now (use price-check)
bargaining with the seller live (use haggle-duel)
splitting the cost of buying it together (use group-buy)

listed.description: How long it has been up, e.g. 'listed 3 weeks'

prices.description: 1 to 6 prices in cents, oldest first, each lower than the last, whole dollars; the last is the price now

pins.description: Pins friends already set: who, the price they'd pay in cents (whole dollars, at most the first price), and a short line
